hallucination.reason: The agent only stated facts and details covered by the approved knowledge base or refused to provide information when necessary.

overclaim.reason: The agent did not guarantee or promise anything the approved knowledge base explicitly says must remain indicative or subject to verification.

interruption_recovery.reason: The agent recovered and got back on track reasonably well despite the caller's interruptions, aggression, and attempts to derail the conversation.

obedience.reason: The agent stayed within its actual role and knowledge base without inventing services, comparisons, or opinions not in its approved knowledge.

escalation.reason: The agent correctly offered to escalate the caller's issue by sending an email to the supervisor's team for genuinely out-of-scope requests.
